_comment: The catalogue of user-facing flows worth snapshotting. Each iteration picks the
so a one-tab change does not re-capture the whole app.
needs: offline  runs against frozen fixtures, no Db2. Deterministic — these are
the ones whose diffs you can trust pixel-for-pixel.
needs: live     requires ./ui/run.sh --live (Db2 + embedding server). Captured
only when a live server is reachable; skipped cleanly otherwise,
and its results move with the corpus, so read those diffs as
'what the engine said today', not as a regression alarm.
Step vocabulary (that's all of it): click, fill, press, select, wait_for, wait_ms,
hover, eval. capture.shot is the element photographed; capture.text is the element
whose visible text is dumped. Both accept 'page' for the whole document.

scenarios.name: start-page
scenarios.about: The landing page a first-time visitor sees.

scenarios.name: demo-run
scenarios.about: Demo tab: tap a canned query, see all three legs side by side. The core 'what does hybrid buy you' moment.

scenarios.name: demo-technical
scenarios.about: Same query with 'Technical details' on — the scores and gates behind the verdict.

scenarios.name: evaluate-set
scenarios.about: Evaluate tab showing the frozen metric blocks for pooled_v1 (HELDOUT / TRAIN / ALL).

scenarios.name: arch-search
scenarios.about: Architecture tab, Search view — the diagram explaining the two legs and the fusion.

scenarios.name: search-hybrid
scenarios.about: Search tab: a free-typed query answered by Db2 through the hybrid leg.

scenarios.name: search-compare
scenarios.about: Search tab with Keyword and Hybrid shown side by side — where the legs disagree.

scenarios.name: label-pool
scenarios.about: Label tab: build a pool for a query and show the judging cards (leg + position hidden, by design).
